claims.claim: Prado Jeep front grill and taillight
claims.evidence: Photo 1 shows a Toyota-emblem grille, but Photo 0 shows headlight units (clear lens, amber trim, mounting tabs) not taillights; model is not confirmed as Prado, only a generic Toyota oval badge is visible
No bulbs, wiring test, or power-on clip shown; photos are static floor shots

claims.claim: Original Toyota part, not China copy
claims.evidence: Emblem visible on grille but no close-up of OEM part number, date stamp, or packaging to confirm authenticity

claims.claim: No crack, all clips and brackets complete
claims.evidence: Photos show mounting tabs/brackets generally but not close enough or well-lit enough to rule out hairline cracks or missing clips

risks.risk: Seller claims taillight but witness only saw headlights and a grille; item mix may be misrepresented
risks.proof: Photo/video clearly showing the actual taillight unit(s) alongside the headlights and grille
risks.if_unproven: price only the headlights + grille as shown, exclude any taillight value

risks.risk: Parts may not actually fit a Prado; model only inferred from generic Toyota emblem
risks.proof: Photo of part number sticker or fitment label matching Prado chassis, or VIN tag of donor vehicle
risks.if_unproven: price as generic unidentified-model Toyota parts, not Prado-specific

risks.risk: Authenticity (OEM vs aftermarket/China copy) cannot be confirmed from distance
risks.proof: Close-up of embossed OEM part number/logo etched into plastic housing
risks.if_unproven: price as aftermarket/copy until OEM markings are shown

risks.risk: Hidden cracks, yellowing, or lens damage not visible under current lighting
risks.proof: Well-lit close-up shots of each lens surface and housing seams from multiple angles

risks.risk: Electrical functionality of headlights unverified (bulbs, wiring, connectors)
risks.proof: Video clip of headlights powered on and lighting up

risks.risk: Headlights may not be a true matching left/right pair for one vehicle
risks.proof: Side-by-side photo showing identical part numbers on both units

risks.risk: Grille clips and brackets completeness not fully visible
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all four corner mounting points and brackets

proof_requests: Photo of the actual taillight unit(s) separate from headlights
Close-up of part number/OEM stamp on grille and headlight housings
Well-lit close-up of each headlight lens and housing for cracks/yellowing
Video of headlights powered on to confirm function
Photo of all grille mounting clips/brackets up close
Any fitment label or VIN tag confirming Prado compatibility
response.reason: Witness confirms only a Toyota-branded grille and a pair of headlights, not a Prado-specific taillight as claimed, so pricing must treat the set at worst case (generic Toyota, unverified authenticity, condition, and function) until the listed proofs are supplied.
